runs.t: Clark Pacific designs, engineers, fabricates and installs high-performance building envelope systems — a single-source solution for architects, owners, and general contractors.
A prefabricated, multi-scope building envelope solution with design and aesthetic flexibility. Integrates structure, insulation, windows, and finishes — factory-built for precision and speed.
Extremely durable facade with flexibility in shapes, finishes, and returns. Supports brick, terra cotta, stone, and 100+ custom textures and colors across any building geometry.
An ideal choice for commercial, industrial, and data center projects — used as cladding or a load-bearing system with customizable thermal performance and finish options.
Lightweight and durable integrated panels with unlimited diversity in color and form. Ideal for complex geometries, thin profiles, and projects where dead load must be minimized.

The building envelope is the most difficult part of any building to design. Design teams are expected to meet client aesthetic goals while satisfying energy codes, waterproofing requirements, and structural constraints — often with multiple subcontractors and conflicting schedules.

Our mission is to turn the building envelope into one of the most rewarding parts of your project — by delivering it as a single-source prefabricated system, designed and built to meet every performance requirement before it leaves the factory.
Single-source accountability eliminates the finger-pointing between trades that drives most envelope failures.
Factory efficiency and parallel fabrication reduce total installed cost vs. traditional multi-subcontractor delivery.
Panels fabricated offsite while foundation and structure proceed — compressing the overall project schedule.
Fewer trades on-site, less scaffolding, and just-in-time delivery reduce congestion and site safety exposures.
Factory production generates a fraction of the waste produced by field-built envelope systems.
Full-height windows, complex reveals, custom finishes — prefabricated systems deliver architectural ambition at scale.
Fixed-price prefabricated scope locks in cost early and protects the owner from field change orders.
Controlled plant environment delivers consistent tolerances, finish quality, and weatherproofing panel to panel.

Beginning with schematic design, our envelope experts walk the team through identification of solutions and materials — optimizing the system for aesthetics, performance, and schedule before documents are complete.
Single-source accountability and constructability determined before manufacturing. Accelerated schedule.
Fewer trades on site and just-in-time delivery reduce congestion, creating a safer site. Factory production generates less waste than field-built systems.
Cal State LA Student Housing East
Infinite Facade® system integrating precast, glazing, and insulation for a 900-unit student housing complex in Los Angeles.
High-performance prefabricated facade system delivering the complex geometry and premium finish quality of a landmark mixed-use tower.
Brick-inlay Infinite Facade® panels achieved the masonry aesthetic of a historic San Diego neighborhood at a fraction of the schedule.
A wide range of standard colors, forms, textures, and finish combinations for our integrated envelope systems.
